module: Career parts inventory. Each part (installed on an inventory vehicle or in storage, location = 0) is an entry of the partInventory table keyed by an integer partId. The module generates a vehicle's parts from its parts tree (partsTree), reconciles them with the actual vehicle after modification, sells stored parts, feeds the "My parts" screen of the garage computer and saves everything to career/partInventory.json (serialized).
usage:
local inv = career_modules_partInventory.getInventory()
local id = career_modules_partInventory.getPartPathToPartIdMap()[inventoryId]["/main/".."partName"]
local part = inv[id]
notes: Part fields: name, value (100 by default), description (JBeam info, not saved), partCondition, tags, vehicleModel, location (0 = storage, otherwise the vehicle's inventoryId), containingSlot (slot path), partPath (= containingSlot .. name), mainPart (slot "/"), and depending on the case year, repairCount, primered.

slotToPartIdMap: location -> containingSlot -> partId. partPathToPartIdMap: inventoryId -> partPath -> partId (only for location > 0). These tables are rebuilt by updateVehicleMaps (asynchronously in onUpdate after a vehicle change).

When a vehicle is added (onVehicleAdded), its parts are added in onUpdate as soon as the vehicle is present and partConditions exists; the onAddedVehiclePartsToInventory(inventoryId, newParts) hook is then emitted.
An auxiliary part (description.isAuxiliary) with value 0 is hidden from the UI and removed from storage.
If the save version is lower than that of the save system, all parts in storage are sold on load. If the save is older than version 42, the inventory is empty.
sellParts silently gives up (selling nothing) if one of the ids is unknown or not in storage; the sale yields the sum of career_modules_valueCalculator.getPartValue, with tags partsSold and selling.
debugMenu (ImGui window) is defined but its call is commented out.

getInventory.desc: Returns the table of all parts (partId -> part), by reference.

getPart.desc: Looks up the part installed in a slot of a vehicle.

getSlotToPartIdMap.desc: Returns the table location -> containingSlot -> partId.

getPartPathToPartIdMap.desc: Returns the table inventoryId -> partPath -> partId (vehicles only).

addPartToInventory.desc: Adds a part under the smallest free partId (starting from 1).

isHiddenInUI.desc: Indicates whether the part must be hidden in the UI: auxiliary (description.isAuxiliary) and of zero value.

sellParts.desc: Sells parts in storage: credits the sum of their values, plays the purchase sound, deletes them and refreshes the UI if the menu is open.

partIds.desc: Ids of the parts to sell (location 0 required).

updatePartConditionsInInventory.desc: Copies into each part the condition (partCondition) known by the vehicle containing it.

updatePartsToMatchSpawnedVehicle.desc: Re-reads the parts of the currently present vehicle and reconciles them with the inventory: updates vehicle.config, keeps condition, tags, year, repairCount and primered of existing parts (same slot), adds new ones (default condition integrity 1, odometer 0, visual 1) and removes those that disappeared. Marks the vehicle as modified.

returns.type: {added: table[], removed: table[], changed: {old: table, new: table}[]}

sendUIData.desc: Sends to the UI (guihooks partInventoryData) the list of visible parts (excluding main parts), their final value, their accessibility (not installed on a vehicle) and the vehicle data.

openMenu.desc: Opens the parts screen: picks the current vehicle or the nearest garage one, updates its part conditions then navigates to career.computer.partInventory.

closeMenu.desc: Closes the screen: if autosave is active and vehicles are modified, saves them first (closing happens in onSaveFinished), otherwise returns directly to the computer or closes the menus.

requestExit.desc: Entry point of the UI router back button: calls closeMenu to keep the autosave behavior.

partInventoryClosed.desc: Notifies that the inventory UI is closed (partInventoryOpen = false).

onRouteMount.desc: UI router lifecycle: sends the inventory data once the view is mounted if the menu is open.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: loads partInventory.json (deserialized), sells parts in storage if the save is of an older version, reloads the JBeam descriptions, removes hidden parts in storage and rebuilds the index tables.

onUpdate.desc: Frame hook: adds the parts of a newly added vehicle and updates the index tables after a vehicle change, as soon as partConditions is available.

onVehicleSaveFinished.desc: Save hook: writes partInventory.json to <save>/career/ (without the description field, via serialize).

onSaveFinished.desc: End-of-save hook: closes the menu if closeMenu was waiting for it.

onEnterVehicleFinished.desc: Hook: schedules the update of the index tables when entering a vehicle.

currentVehicle.desc: Inventory id of the current vehicle.

onPartShoppingTransactionComplete.desc: Hook: after a parts purchase, removes hidden parts in storage and rebuilds the indexes.

onVehicleAdded.desc: Hook: remembers the vehicle whose parts must be added in onUpdate.

onVehicleRemoved.desc: Hook: removes all parts located on the removed vehicle.

onComputerAddFunctions.desc: Computer hook: adds the "My parts" function (order 5), disabled while the starter vehicle is not bought.
